theorem_statement: T 3×10×z is tileable iff z belongs to the semigroup generated by {10, 14, 26, 27, 28, 30, 31, ..., 96}. All z >= 30 are tileable. z=29 is the largest non-tileable thickness (Frobenius).

semigroup.description: Cofinite semigroup. All z >= 30 are tileable. z=29 is the only non-tileable thickness >= 10.
